items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I was meeting real people down there, all the actors and everything. (Unintelligible) Nicolas (PHONETIC) and all those big actors, because they hung out there.

ctx.x: That was over the Saint Germain, we called it, sector. That was by the cathedral of Notre Dame. Those people, they were students, so I didn't meet too many of them. I was down meeting the Clush(?) D'Or people down there. I was meeting real people down there, all the actors and everything. (Unintelligible) Nicolas (PHONETIC) and all those big actors, because they hung out there.
So now, we're in the early '60s now?
